summary: Phase B Calendar Overhaul (items #3-#6) verified end-to-end on web + mobile with shared backend. 22/22 pytest tests pass on /api/visits CRUD + new kinds (gp/specialist/allied_health/nurse/home_visit/telehealth/assessment/social_support/transport/respite/medication/reminder/personal/other/appointment) + all_day boolean; invalid kind correctly rejected with 422. Web /app/calendar renders react-big-calendar month grid, tinted form with 15 Type options + 9 duration presets + 'Custom...' revealing visits-form-duration-custom, submit creates entry, list (visits-list) exposes search/filter and per-row edit/cancel/delete. Mobile /calendar (react-native-calendars) renders calendar-month, day/all toggle works, form opens with explicit Required/Optional markers on every label, submit creates entry, cards expand to edit/cancel/archive/delete.

issues: Required/Optional markers are rendered via <RequiredMark/> and <OptionalMark/> components but on desktop the visual glyph is very small (text-xs muted). Consider labelling with explicit 'Required' text like mobile does, so parity between platforms improves. Non-blocking.

parity_issues.issue: Mobile shows explicit 'Required' / 'Optional' text next to every label; web only shows a tiny asterisk/glyph via <RequiredMark/>. Both are technically present, but the on-screen text 'Required' is missing on web, whereas the task said 'must show which fields are Required'.
parity_issues.expected: Both surfaces show an obvious 'Required' text on required fields.
parity_issues.actual: Web relies on a subtle marker; mobile shows the word 'Required'.

action_items: (Optional/parity) Make web required-field marker use the word 'Required' like mobile so users clearly see which inputs are mandatory.
critical_code_review_comments: VisitBody.duration_minutes is validated ge=5, le=720 — matches UI custom-duration input min=5/max=720. Good.

PATCH /visits uses the same VisitBody so every update must resend all required fields (title/starts_at). This is fine because both UIs reconstruct full drafts before submitting, but a PartialVisitBody would be safer if a future surface tries to update a single field.
seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up 22 backend TEST_iter340 visits + 2 UI-created (web + mobile) visits.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/visits + new taxonomy + all_day are green. Web + mobile calendar overhaul work end-to-end for cathy@example.com. Only cosmetic parity nit: web required-field markers are visually subtle vs mobile's explicit 'Required' text. Preview backend can be slow (login ~20s) — use pytest timeout>=60.
